Treasurer Office
Mary McGuire
Contact
(308) 428-3535
(308) 428-4009
treasurer@greeleycountyne.gov
Brenda Kehler
Deputy
Treasurer
Duties:
Invest and monitor county funds
Issue drivers license
Issue motor vehicle titles
Assess and register vehicles and watercraft
Notification of taxes, real estate and personal property
Collection of taxes real estate and personal property
Distribution of taxes to enitities and state
Collection of water assessments
Collection and distribution of state aid
Collection of county miscellaneous revenues
Conduct sale of delinquent taxes
Notification of motor vehicle renewal
Issue and redeem tax sale certificates
Collect special assessments
Supply County Sheriff with distress warrant listing
Daily and monthly reports
Record and file permanent records
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
